remarks: Luxurious Penthouse Condo with extraordinary water & city views day & night. This unique five story building is for the discerning person wishing for a private elevator, a separate entrance, with only 2 units per floor. The setting has a vacation ambience that satisfies the desire to be "on the water". Walk to the beaches, or around the well maintained grounds to enjoy the sun sets & boats. All shopping, restaurants, schools, and commuter trains, and vibrant downtown Stamford, are all within minutes away. Special features are a remodeled kitchen with top of the line appliances, Quartz 10 foot breakfast counter, abundant custom cabinetry & lighting. The main floor all new porcelain bathroom, has a wow factor!  Second floor bedroom with celestial views, has en suite whirlpool tub, & shower, double new sinks and counter. New vinyl floor, attic storage space & double closets, it's serene. Living in style and convenience for year round seasonal fun from the balcony that over looks the marina mobility with pleasure. Stroll around, when the cherry trees bloom it glorious! Our most premier water community of Shippan Point has the best offerings available for all water lovers!
